messages:
anya: FYI: nightly importer failed for ~118 invoices this morning with attachment decode errors. Seeing lots of `illegal base64 character` in the logs.

finance-sync-bot: FAILED_IMPORT batch_id=20240414-03 reason=attachment_decode_error count=118

sarah: Which step produces the PDFs? stripe -> packager -> s3 -> netsuite-importer, right?

mike: Yup. We shipped a tiny pdf-renderer/font-subsetting tweak on 04/12. Also toggled an `upload_as_text` flag in the packager that week. Could be related.

anya: Sample: `Attachment decode failed: illegal base64 character 20` — looks like whitespace or extra headers got into the payload.

tomas: Might be double-encoding: packager base64s then uploader sets Content-Encoding:gzip and importer tries to base64 decode once.

nick: Pulling the batch from S3 now: s3://invoices-prod/2024/04/14/batch-20240414-03.zip. Zip shows PDF bytes but manifest has charset on filenames.

sarah: If files were base64'd twice that would explain it. Can someone grep for `upload_as_text` usage in the packager history?

mike: Found the 04/12 commit: set upload_as_text=true to avoid name mangling for non-ascii filenames. I'll rollback that toggle if it matches.

tomas: I'll open a small importer hotfix to detect double-base64 safely: try decode, if resulting bytes look like a PDF header `%PDF-`, accept; else fail more gracefully and flag for manual review. PR: fix/importer-detect-double-base64.

anya: We need these in NetSuite by EOD. Can we reprocess the failed batch now?

nick: I can manual re-ingest: unzip, normalise encoding, POST to importer with Content-Type:application/pdf, Content-Transfer-Encoding:binary. Will take ~30-45m. Starting now.

finance-sync-bot: REPROCESS_STARTED batch_id=20240414-03 initiated_by=nick

mike: Rolling back `upload_as_text` now. If rollback succeeds I'll re-run the packager for 04/14.

tomas: Hotfix PR ready. Adds PDF header probe and a fallback decode attempt, plus a non-blocking alert path.

nick: Reprocess done. All 118 imported; spot-checked three invoices in NetSuite.

finance-sync-bot: REPROCESS_COMPLETE batch_id=20240414-03 status=ok imported=118

anya: Great work. Next steps: mike keeps rollback and a postmortem on why `upload_as_text` got toggled; tomas to get importer guard merged; nick to add a quick checklist for manual re-ingest. I'll draft a short incident note for finance-runbook. :thumbsup:
